meta.title: Your Activity Forest — Daily Page
meta.description: Walk through the private forest grown from your Daily Page writing.

forestScene.heading: Your writing, growing into a place
forestScene.introduction: Walk through the grove formed by your writing. This first view stays quiet and focused on returning to the work behind each tree.
forestScene.help: Move with the arrow keys or WASD, or touch and drag in the forest. Press Enter or E near a tree or marker, or select it directly, to inspect it. In marker placement mode, press Enter to save or Escape to cancel.

markers.unavailable: Markers couldn’t be synchronized. Writing and movement remain available.
markers.stale: Markers couldn’t be synchronized. Visible markers may be out of date.
markers.migrationRequired: Your markers need an update before they can be shown or changed.
markers.resetting: Your markers are being cleared. Marker actions will return when that finishes.
markers.heading: A place you marked
markers.description: This quiet marker is private account state, separate from your writing trees.
markers.removeConfirmation: Remove this marker? There is no restore action in this prototype.
markers.previewClear: This place looks clear. Placement is verified when saved.
markers.previewTreeCollision: Move farther from the writing tree.
markers.previewBounds: This position is outside the supported forest coordinates.
markers.previewDensity: This area has reached its provisional marker-density limit.
markers.conflict: This marker changed elsewhere. Its current saved state has been restored here.
markers.collision: That position conflicts with forest state not visible here. Choose another place.
markers.density: That area cannot accept another marker right now. Choose another place.
markers.unavailableMutation: The marker could not be saved right now. You can retry the same request or cancel.
markers.rateLimited: Marker changes are temporarily limited. Please wait, then retry.
markers.removedElsewhere: This marker is no longer available. The nearby marker view has been refreshed.
markers.syncingPending: Saving a marker change in the background…
markers.syncingPendingMany: Saving several marker changes in the background…
markers.unsyncedPending: A marker change has not synchronized yet.
markers.unsyncedPendingMany: Several marker changes have not synchronized yet.
markers.pendingMarker: This marker is still synchronizing. You can keep exploring while it saves.
markers.pendingMarkerFailed: This marker has not synchronized yet. Use the recovery controls at the top of the forest.
markers.revertedPending: The unsynchronized marker change was reverted.

inspect.loading: Remembering the writing held by this tree…
inspect.unavailable: This tree’s writing is not available right now.
inspect.reconciling: Your forest is still updating. Please try this tree again shortly.
inspect.inclusionConflict: This tree changed elsewhere. Close and inspect it again before retrying.
inspect.inclusionUnavailable: This tree could not be hidden right now. Please try again.
inspect.treeHidden: The tree was hidden. You can restore it from Hidden trees in your writing grove.

forestScene.noScript: The visual forest requires JavaScript, but all represented writing remains available in the writing grove.

empty.heading: Your forest is ready to begin
empty.body: Write an eligible post and its tree will begin establishing your private forest.

reconciling.heading: Your forest is growing
reconciling.body: We are checking your writing and preparing an up-to-date grove. Please return shortly.

unavailable.heading: Your forest is temporarily unavailable
unavailable.body: We could not safely load the forest right now. Your writing remains available from the writing grove.
